title: Recording: Golden Blunders, Angel In Disguise by Ringo Starr | 1991
content:
Studio F, Los Angeles
Producer: Peter Asher
Engineer: Frank Wolf

Ringo Starr continued recording two songs for his tenth solo album, Time Takes Time, on 13 September 1991.

The backing track for ‘Golden Blunders’ had been recorded on 9 September, with more overdubs added on 11 and 12 September. It was completed on this day.

Also worked on was ‘Angel In Disguise’, which had also been started on 9 September. More overdubs were recorded on 11, 12, and 18 September, but the song, a co-write by Starr and Paul McCartney, was left unreleased.
